big_case.notes: A genuine post-Ramos question (whether the predicate acts of a continuous-course-of-conduct offense are elements requiring unanimity) that reaches continuous-sexual-abuse statutes in Texas and several other states and long sentences under them. But the petition alleged no split, drew no amici, and was denied without any noted dissent or statement after one full-briefing conference; the denial drew no visible reaction. Specialist criminal-procedure stakes, below the median of the elevated band.
